title: Mum Came Home Early… But She Just Texted Me #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Imagine you're home alone after school.
The front door opens. "I'm home early!" It's Mum.
She smiles and goes into the kitchen.
Your phone buzzes. A text from Mum.
"Stuck in traffic. Home in two hours. Don't open the door."
In the kitchen, someone is humming Mum's song.
"Come and help me, beta," the voice calls.
You look at the shoes by the door. They're on the wrong feet.
*"Why are you texting, beta? I'm right here."
Would you go to the kitchen, or run outside? Comment A or B.

texts: Stuck in traffic. Home in two hours.
